dataset.name: Cho2017
dataset.citation: Cho H., Ahn M., Ahn S., Kwon M., Jun S.C. EEG datasets for motor imagery brain-computer interface. GigaScience 2017;6(7):gix034. DOI 10.1093/gigascience/gix034
dataset.channels: 64 EEG in the 10-10 system plus 4 arm EMG, 68 total

differences_from_the_bnci_branch.epoch_s: 3.0 stored, 0.5-3.0 s analysed. Cho2017 provides about 3 s of imagery; the 4 s epoch of the BNCI branch does not exist here.
differences_from_the_bnci_branch.notch_hz: 60.0, not 50.0. The recordings are Korean mains.
differences_from_the_bnci_branch.clean_reference_rms: per subject, from the training trials of each fold. The BNCI branch uses one scalar, 4.4, for the whole dataset. Cho amplitudes differ between people, so one scalar would be meaningless.
differences_from_the_bnci_branch.cross_validation: five contiguous folds per class. Cho2017 does not expose run boundaries, so leave-one-run-out is unavailable.
differences_from_the_bnci_branch.car_check: relative, not absolute. harmkit.validate uses an absolute tolerance of 1e-3 calibrated for microvolts; raw Cho units are about 1e4 larger. Observed relative residual: median 6.77e-08, max 1.60e-07, which is float32 epsilon.

preprocessing.reference: CAR over exactly the 19 COMMON19 channels
preprocessing.detrend: linear, per channel, BEFORE any resampling. Mandatory: raw BioSemi carries a residual per-channel offset with median 135158 after CAR19, and resample_poly zero-pads by default.
preprocessing.resample: scipy.signal.resample_poly with padtype='line'. Never the default 'constant'.
preprocessing.band_power_method: Welch PSD, nperseg 512 at the native rate, mains bins dropped at 60/120/180 Hz plus and minus 2 Hz. Never a time-domain band-pass on a short block.

donors.jaw_slot_basis: measured, not taken from the publication's prose ordering, which would give 4. Slot 4 holds head movement.
donors.feasibility_gate: MI_d = P(40-100 Hz) of the donor window over P(40-100 Hz) of the same subject's resting block, threshold 3.0, at least 20 of 47 confirmatory subjects. Result: 45/47.
donors.working_threshold: purity >= 0.90, where purity = 1 - P_20_80(own resting median) / P_20_80(donor). A LOWER bound on the muscle fraction, not an estimate.

decoder.eligibility: clean out-of-fold accuracy >= 0.60, unchanged from the BNCI branch

snr_grid_db.natural_point: per host, the median natural SNR of that host's own jaw donors, applied identically in all three arms
snr_grid_db.extension_reason: the measured natural SNR has median -10.79 dB with 75.9 per cent of donor windows harsher than the frozen grid and none milder

numerical_guarantees.harm_engine_vs_harmkit: all counters identical across four SNR grids and five seeds; scale factors identical to 0.0
